name: Factory Droid
tagline: Factory's coding agent for terminal, desktop, web, and cloud, with multi-agent Missions.
description: Droid is Factory's coding agent, available through a terminal TUI, a desktop app, web and mobile surfaces, IDE extensions, and headless execution. It supports multi-agent Missions, custom Droids, skills, MCP, hooks, and bring-your-own-key models.

pricing.notes: Pro $20/mo, Plus $100/mo, Max $200/mo; Teams, Business, and Enterprise tiers. No free tier listed.
